stage_ref: p11_remaining_coord01 / Owner Access Paper successor independent fidelity review
material_selection_reason: The candidate needs a fresh reviewer who did not author it and can inspect real Paper content, rendered bilingual states, responsive family preservation, and the human-locked password/secret-free boundary. External providers, Luna, and Terra fail the current Paper qualification or explicit human routing filter. A native SOL subagent is selected read-only; the coordinator retains acceptance and final fidelity judgment.

direct-coordinator: The coordinator authored the candidate and therefore is not independent for this gate.
deepseek-v4-pro: Real Paper design-content reads and screenshots are not qualified.
glm-5.3: Real Paper design-content reads and screenshots are not qualified.
native-terra: The human instruction excludes Terra from Paper mutation and provides no current advantage for this fidelity review.
native-luna: The human instruction excludes Luna from Paper mutation; this gate also requires high-consequence bilingual fidelity judgment.

access_boundary.readable: the frozen Owner Access successor, its preserved source family, and directly relevant FITWAY product/spec/ADR/visual authority
access_boundary.forbidden: every Paper mutation, every repository write, unrelated Paper families, secret material, and further delegation
